title: Over the Rainbow
content:
[Intro & Lautgesang]
[G] [D] [Em] [C]
[G] [D] [Em] [Cadd9] [C]
Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh...
[G] [D] [C] [G]
[C] [B7] [Em] [C]
Mmm, mmm, mmm, mmm...

[Strophe 1]
Somewhere [G] over the rainbow, [C] way up [G] high
And the [C] dreams that you dream of [G] once in a lullaby [D] [Em] [C]

[Strophe 2]
Somewhere [G] over the rainbow, [D] blue birds [Em] fly [C]
And the [G] dreams that you dream of, [C] dreams really do come [G] true

[Bridge]
Someday I'll [G] wish upon a star
[D] Wake up where the clouds are far [Em] behind [C] me
Where [G] trouble melts like lemon drops
[D] High above the chimney tops, that's [Em] where you'll [C] find me

[Strophe 3]
Somewhere [G] over the rainbow, [D] bluebirds [Em] fly [C]
And the [G] dreams that you dare to, [D] oh why, oh [C] why can't [G] I?

[Outro]
Well, I see [G] trees of green and [D] red roses [C] too [G]
I'll see them [C] bloom for [B7] me and [Em] you [C]
And I [C] think to myself... [D] What a wonderful [G] world! [C] [G]
